note: The dependency direction of ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md, as data.
An entry's `imports` is the complete set of Portolan packages that package may import.
There is no arrow back up, anywhere.
Three things are generated from this file and one test guards it:
- eslint.config.mjs builds a per-package no-restricted-imports rule from it;
- vite.config.ts builds the browser alias map from it;
- test/envelope.test.ts asserts every package.json and tsconfig.json agrees with it,
and that the package list still matches the spine's Structural Seed.
Editing this file without editing the package manifests it describes fails the test.
